conclusion.short: Japan's SBIC is not one uniquely identifiable company. Official sources identify three sister regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies: Tokyo (East Japan), Nagoya (Central Japan) and Osaka (West Japan). They were established in 1963 under the Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Company Act. They are separate from SBI Holdings/SBI Group.
conclusion.acronym_expansion: Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation
conclusion.legal_basis: Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Company Act, Act No. 101 of 1963
conclusion.caution: The acronym SBIC is also used in unrelated contexts, including the U.S. Small Business Investment Company program and the academic Social Bias Inference Corpus dataset. The exact phrase 'ChatGPT SBIC' is context-dependent.
